item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The segment is an introductory authority clause and section heading; it identifies the President and announces that operative directions follow but itself directs no agency action or legal consequence.","evidence":"hereby proclaim and direct as follows"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"Although subsection (a) directs executive process creation, subsection (b) itself mandates Federal funding for qualifying flights, presently establishing a substantive funding obligation when such flights are provided.","evidence":"shall be funded by the Federal Government"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretaries are directed to take appropriate implementation actions and establish an administrative concierge service; the segment does not itself award the referenced bonus or independently alter immigration status.","evidence":"shall create a concierge service"},{"segment_id":"4","code":2,"rationale":"The segment mandates the Secretaries to produce a specified later financial benefit—an exit bonus—for every qualifying departing alien.","evidence":"shall provide financial incentives in the form of an \"exit bonus\""},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The segment mandates an informational campaign and expansion of the Department's enforcement workforce through deputizing and contracting, which are executive communications, staffing, and operational-management measures rather than themselves removals or confiscations.","evidence":"shall supplement existing enforcement and removal operations by deputizing and contracting"}]}
